scores.notes: Watson has brown hair and a full moustache in both (bowler-hatted man with bag on the left, man lying on the bed on the right); right face is partly covered by his forearm but hair, moustache, age and build match.

Both show a calm dawn lakeshore with a flat-roofed stone village at the water's edge, cypresses and a coal fire on the bank; right adds palms and is seen from the water, which is a compatible viewpoint change.

Watson is a middle-aged man with dark brown side-parted hair and a trimmed moustache in both (by the door on the left, seated by the bed on the right); right face is a little heavier but no cue conflicts.

Daniel is the older man with short grey hair, trimmed grey beard, tan skin and a blue mantle with a shoulder satchel in both (centre left, right foreground right); small on the right but the cues match.
Alice is a girl of the same age with long light-brown hair, black headband and fair skin in both; hair is wavier on the left and straighter on the right, but face and colouring match.

Both show a sandy seabed corridor between towering green wave walls running back to pale desert dunes; right adds red cliffs and a lighter sky, compatible with a different viewpoint along the same path.
Holmes is the gaunt, clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, high forehead and aquiline nose in both (throwing the paper ball left, holding the magnifier right).

Holmes is lean, clean-shaven and dark-haired with hair brushed back and a sharp nose in both; the right face looks older and more gaunt with a higher hairline, but the left is a small upturned profile and no cue clearly conflicts.
Moses is an old man with long white hair, full white beard, cream robe and brown mantle with a staff in both (arm outstretched at the sea left, seated on the stone right).

Both show the same open wooden boat with a mast lantern on a dark night lake, a hilly shore with a small village on the left and the moon low over the far shore; rougher water on the right is the asked-for storm.
Holmes is the tall gaunt clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, high forehead and hooked nose in both (seated in the carriage left, pulling Watson in at the door right).
Holmes is the tall gaunt clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair and a hooked nose in both (pointing at the red-haired client left, tossing the paper ball right).
Peter (diving from the boat left, lifting the lame man right) has short dark curly hair, a short dark beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build in both; the left face is angled down but the cues agree.

Peter in the left courtyard foreground has mostly grey curly hair and a grey beard and looks around sixty, while the man lifting the beggar on the right has dark hair with only light greying and looks younger; grey versus dark hair conflicts.
Both show the same wooden fishing boat on a lake ringed by steep dark cliffs and headlands under heavy storm cloud in daylight; calmer water and breaking light on the right is the asked-for calm.

Alice has the same long light-brown hair with a dark headband, fair skin and girlish face in both (smiling with the flamingo left, frowning in court right); she is drawn a little taller on the right but identity cues match.

Moses is the old man with white hair, full white beard, cream robe and brown mantle holding a staff in both (striking the rock left, leading the crowd on the right); hair is slightly longer on the left.
Peter (stepping onto the water left, the dripping-wet man by the fire right) has short dark curly hair with some grey, a short greying dark beard, tanned skin and a stocky build in both.
Moses is the old man with swept-back white hair, long white beard, cream robe and dark brown mantle with a staff in both (arm out over the sea left, pointing ahead in the crowd right).
Watson is the sturdy man with short brown hair and a full brown moustache in both (in waistcoat on the bed left, in bowler and overcoat in the carriage right); age and face shape agree.

Both show a calm pale-morning lake ringed by tan hills with a stony shore, a coal fire at the waterline, cypresses and olive trees; the right adds palms and hillside houses seen from the boat, a compatible viewpoint.

Holmes on the left has a thick full head of dark wavy hair falling over his forehead and a younger fuller face; on the right he is markedly balding with a high bare forehead and thin slicked hair and an older gaunt face.
Moses is an old tanned man with white hair, white beard, cream robe, brown mantle and staff in both; hair and beard are somewhat longer on the right but colour, age and build match.
Holmes is the lean clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, high forehead and sharp nose in both (seated with pipe and photograph left, standing pointing right).
Holmes is the gaunt clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, hollow cheeks and hooked nose in both (striking with the cane left, holding the magnifier and hat right).

Left is a narrow lake in pale twilight with terraced hillside villages close on both shores; right is open water at full night under a moon with lightning and only faint distant shore, and no description asks for a night/day change.
Jesus has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same face and build, and a cream robe with blue mantle in both (standing in the bow left, on the water at right).
Alice is the same young girl with long straight light-brown hair, dark headband and fair skin in both (with the flamingo left, drinking from the bottle in the hall right).

David is a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, fair-tan skin and a rough brown tunic in both (crouched at the brook left, kneeling under the oil right); his head is bowed on the right but hair, age and build match.

Peter is clear on the left (the dark-curly-haired bearded man diving), but on the right eleven near-identical dark-bearded men in brown cloaks stand round the fire and nothing singles out which is Peter.

Both show the same hill-country farmstead: pale flat-roofed stone houses behind a low dry-stone wall, olive trees, cypresses and terraced hills under a clear daytime sky, seen from the road and then from the yard.

Both show a sunlit grass croquet lawn enclosed by tall clipped hedges with autumn-tinted trees behind and clusters of large mushrooms at the edge; hoops are card soldiers on the left and plain arches on the right, but the ground itself matches.
Moses is the old man with swept-back white hair, full white beard, cream robe, brown mantle and crook-topped staff in both (arm out at the sea left, looking up in the camp right).
Holmes is the gaunt clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, hollow cheeks and hooked nose in both (probing with the cane left, tossing the paper ball right).
Holmes is the thin clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, high forehead and sharp nose in both (seated with pipe by the lamp left, in the carriage right).

Watson is the stocky man with brown hair and a full brown moustache in both (bowler-hatted on the pavement left, sitting on the bed shading his eyes right); he is small in both but hair, moustache and build agree.

Alice is a small girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and the same slight build in both; she is seen partly from behind in the court on the left, so the match rests on hair, age and build rather than the face.
Moses is the old man with white hair, full white beard, cream robe, brown mantle and crook-topped staff in both; he is small at the right edge of the sea crossing but the cues are visible and match.
David is a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, light-tan skin and a brown tunic with shoulder bag in both (stooping at the brook left, kneeling to be anointed right).

Both are a night scene under heavy dark storm cloud with the same green foaming sea drawn back from a wet sandy bed; the left sees the opening from the beach, the right looks along the corridor between the water walls, a compatible viewpoint.
David is a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, fair-tan skin and a plain brown tunic in both (kneeling with head bowed left, dodging the spear right).
David is a slim beardless youth with short dark hair and a brown belted tunic in both; he is small in the left battlefield but hair, age, build and skin tone match the right.
Daniel is the older lean man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tan skin and a blue fringed mantle over a cream robe in both (in the den left, before the king right).

Peter (stepping out of the boat left, the man with net and staff clasping the beggar's hand right) has short dark curly hair touched with grey, a short greying dark beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build in both.

Holmes on the left is an older gaunt man with thin receding slicked-back hair and a high bare forehead; on the right he has a thick full head of wavy dark hair over the forehead and a younger, fuller face.
Both show the same round open-topped pit lined with grey stone blocks on sandy ground, with a barred grate under a wooden hatch at the rim and palms behind, in pale early daylight.

Both show a walled garden lawn of ridged turf under a grey cloudy sky, ringed by tall trees and conifers with a garden wall behind and hedgehogs and card soldiers on the grass; the wall reads greyer on the left and redder on the right, a minor difference.
Jesus has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same lean face and build and a cream robe with grey-blue mantle in both (at the tomb left, standing in the stern right).
Both show the same wooden boat with a tall curved stern post in a daytime gale, dark rain cloud overhead, white-capped grey-blue waves and the same line of dark cliffs on the right horizon.
Jesus is clear on the left (long dark hair, dark beard, blue mantle), but on the right he is a tiny distant figure on the centre cross with head bowed, too small to judge face or beard.

David is a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, tanned skin and a ragged brown tunic with shoulder bag in both (picking stones at the brook left, ducking the spear with his harp right).
David is a slim beardless youth with short black curly hair, tanned skin and a rough brown tunic with shoulder bag in both; he is smaller on the right battlefield but hair, age and build match.

Jesus has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a dark beard, lean build and the same skin tone in both; on the right he is small on the centre cross with head bowed, but hair, beard and build are still readable in daylight and agree.
Moses is the old man with long white hair, full white beard, cream robe and dark brown mantle with a staff in both (pointing at the pig left, seated with arms held up right).

Holmes on the left is clearly balding, with a bare high crown and thin hair only swept back at the sides; the small figure with the pipe on the right has a full head of dark slicked-back hair, so the hairline conflicts though both are gaunt and clean-shaven.

Holmes is a lean clean-shaven man in his thirties with a full head of dark hair, long face and sharp nose in both; hair falls forward on the left and is brushed back in the right profile, but colour, age and build agree.

Watson is the solid man with brown hair and a full brown moustache in both (arms folded in waistcoat left, small figure in bowler and brown suit with bag right); the right is small but moustache, colouring and build match.

Holmes is the tall lean clean-shaven man with dark swept-back hair, high forehead and sharp hooked nose in both (standing with the paper ball left, reaching with the cane right); the right looks slightly older but no cue clearly conflicts.

Both show the same open wooden boat with a single mast and a stern cushion on wide open water under heavy dark storm cloud; the right is the storm at its height with no shore visible, the left the asked-for calm with distant headlands.
